# Sofia Alvarez — Chief Revenue Officer

- **Relationship:** peer on the exec team; owns sales and customer success. Frequently the
  source of enterprise feature and reliability demands landing on engineering.
- **Cadence:** weekly 1:1, Tuesdays 11:00 (Maya usually defends this despite deep-work block).
- **What she cares about:** the 99.95% SLA in enterprise contracts, security questionnaires
  (tied to [Sentinel](../projects/sentinel.md)), and roadmap commitments she can sell.

## How to work with her
- She'll trade a feature for reliability if you show the revenue at risk from churn.
- Give her SOC 2 status in plain language — she puts it directly into deals.
- She pushes hard; agree on a written commitment so "sales promises" don't drift.

## Sensitivities
- The June SLA breach cost her a renewal conversation; she is watching
  [Meridian](../projects/meridian.md) closely and wants weekly status.
